title: Replace bare .unwrap() with .expect() in lichen-senml tests
description: lichen-senml/src/wire.rs test functions have 50+ bare .unwrap() calls. Replace each with .expect('description of what was expected to succeed'). E.g. .unwrap() after encode → .expect('SenML encode failed'). Do not change test logic. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-senml
